references.text: God meets Moses at the testimony (the ark of the covenant) in the tent of meeting, the same place as in Numbers 17:19
The tent of meeting is the place where God meets his people and speaks with them
The testimony (the ark of the covenant) is placed in the tent of meeting where God meets Moses
Before the testimony in the tent of meeting is the place where God meets Moses
The fulfillment of the command to lay the staffs before the testimony, and Aaron's staff that budded
Other objects were also laid before the testimony as a sign for the children of Israel
Hebrews mentions Aaron's staff that budded, kept in the ark of the covenant before the testimony
